data.one_liner: A Dart package for validating emails, URLs, IP addresses, and other common input formats using regex.
data.what_it_does: Validator_regex provides simple helper methods to validate standard input strings such as email addresses, URLs, IP addresses, digits, alphanumeric strings, passwords, and credit card numbers using regular expressions. It can be used to quickly verify user input in Flutter applications.
use_when: You need to validate common user input formats like emails, URLs, and IP addresses in a Flutter application.
You want a lightweight utility library for checking password strength, digits, or credit card numbers.
avoid_when: You need complex form state management or a full form building engine.
strengths: Provides a wide variety of out-of-the-box string validation methods (emails, URLs, IPs, credit cards, passwords).
Simple and straightforward static method API.
weaknesses: Relies purely on regex patterns which may not cover every edge case of complex specifications.
Limited documentation on advanced customization of the underlying regex patterns.

alternatives.name: email_validator
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose email_validator if you specifically require a robust, dedicated package solely focused on email address validation.
